title: Cambridge IELTS 21 Test 3 Writing Task 2
prompt: All university undergraduate courses should include a period of time spent studying abroad or doing a work placement.
directions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
scenario: All university undergraduate courses should include a period of time spent studying abroad or doing a work placement.
requirements: Do you think the advantages of this would outweigh the disadvantages?
Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
